in_sanskrit.name: सर्वर्ज
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sarvam Raja: One who rules all, Sarvam Rath: One who has chariot of all, Sarvam Raja Rasayana: Elixir of all kings

in_marathi.name: Sarfarz
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sarfarz हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sarfarz is a combination of two Persian words - Sar meaning 'king' and Farz meaning 'duty'. The name is a powerful one, suggesting someone who is a brave and valiant king, fulfilling his duties and leading his people with courage.
